text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle is Neo Universe's... "Giant 
Impact"... you see.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did I really make that much of an 
impression? I honestly thought I was 
pretty average and ordinary~.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle is "BRGT"... The "Alpha 
Star" found in the "Starfield"—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oh! ...Ah, huh? Ahaha, thanks, thank you~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's a little hard to understand, but I 
can totally feel how much you want to 
celebrate with me~.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Connect" with Neo Universe— ...Thank you 
for 『connecting』 with me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! As long as our hearts connect 
properly, everything's totally okay~.
